svg.title: NOAA ETOPO1 modern relief with elevations between minus 0 metres and zero highlighted
svg.desc: Modern land in light green, shallow negative elevations in gold, deeper water in blue. This is a depth screen, not a reconstruction of a dated ancient coastline. Inland depressions are not excluded. Numbered markers are approximate project locations.
